list-preference.label: List Preference
list-preference.helpText: Choose whether to use the whitelist, blacklist, both or none (disable the app).

ignore-preference.label: Ignore Posts?
ignore-preference.helpText: Select whether to ignore posts that have been approved, removed or ones filtered by AutoModerator.

whitelist.label: Whitelist
whitelist.helpText: Requirements for posts on which the bot will act on (all non-empty requirements given must be true).

wl-title-regex.label: Title Regex
wl-title-regex.helpText: Regex pattern for post titles to act on.

wl-body-regex.label: Body Regex
wl-body-regex.helpText: Regex pattern for post body to act on.

wl-body-link.label: Post body contains a link?
wl-body-link.helpText: Enable to act on posts with a link in the post body.

wl-body-length.label: Minimum Post Body Length
wl-body-length.helpText: Specify the minimum number of characters required in the post body (the number of characters must be greater than or equal to the given number).

wl-flair-text.label: Flair Text
wl-flair-text.helpText: Comma-separated flair text to whitelist (e.g. "Discussion, Announcement") - an exact but non-case-sensitive match is required ("Off-topic" and "off-topic" is fine).

wl-user-flair-text.label: User Flair Text
wl-user-flair-text.helpText: Comma-separated user flair text to whitelist - an exact but non-case-sensitive match is required.

wl-user-flair-ids.label: User Flair IDs
wl-user-flair-ids.helpText: Comma-separated user flair IDs to whitelist.

blacklist.label: Blacklist
blacklist.helpText: Requirements for posts posts on which the bot will NOT act on (all non-empty requirements given must be false).

bl-title-regex.label: Title Regex
bl-title-regex.helpText: Regex pattern for post titles to exclude.

bl-body-regex.label: Body Regex
bl-body-regex.helpText: Regex pattern for post bodies to exclude.

bl-body-link.label: Post body contains a link?
bl-body-link.helpText: Enable to exclude posts with a link in their body.

bl-body-length.label: Post Body Length Limit
bl-body-length.helpText: Exclude posts that contain a number of characters greater than or equal to the one given

bl-flair-text.label: Flair Text
bl-flair-text.helpText: Comma-separated flair text to blacklist (e.g. "Meme, Off-topic") - an exact, but non-case-sensitive match is required ("Off-topic" and "off-topic" is fine).

bl-user-flair-text.label: User Flair Text
bl-user-flair-text.helpText: Comma-separated user flair text to blacklist - an exact but non-case-sensitive match is required.

bl-user-flair-ids.label: User Flair IDs
bl-user-flair-ids.helpText: Comma-separated user flair IDs to blacklist.

comment-requirements.label: Comment Requirements
comment-requirements.helpText: Configure the requirements for the comment that should be made.

comment-ignore-preference.label: Ignore Removed/Filtered Comments?
comment-ignore-preference.helpText: Select whether to ignore removed comments, ones filtered by AutoModerator, or both.

comment-level.label: Check top-level comments?
comment-level.helpText: Enable this to check top-level comments.

comment-author.label: Check non-OP comments?
comment-author.helpText: Enable this to check comments made by users other than the author of the post.

comment-user-ignore.label: Ignore List
comment-user-ignore.helpText: Comma-separated usernames to ignore (without the u/ prefix).

accept-any-comment.label: Accept Any Comment?
accept-any-comment.helpText: Enable this to bypass all comment requirements (except the above) and accept any comment.

comment-body-regex.label: Comment Body Regex
comment-body-regex.helpText: Regex pattern that the comment body must match. Ignored if "Accept Any Comment" is enabled.

comment-body-link.label: Require a Link in Comment Body?
comment-body-link.helpText: Enable to enforce the presence of a link in the comment body. Ignored if "Accept Any Comment" is enabled.

notice-comment-settings.label: Notice Comment Settings
notice-comment-settings.helpText: Settings for the notice comment to be made under posts that match the Post Requirements but lack the required comment.

reminder-enable.label: Enable Notice?
reminder-enable.helpText: Enable to send a notice comment.

reminder-delay.label: Notice Delay (minutes)
reminder-delay.helpText: Time (in minutes) to wait before sending the notice. Notices with a delay of under 10 minutes will instead be sent immediately.

reminder-remove-delay.label: Notice Removal Delay (minutes)
reminder-remove-delay.helpText: Time (in minutes) to wait before removing the notice after it has been sent. The notice won't be removed if the value is 0.

reminder-message.label: Custom Notice Message
reminder-message.helpText: The message to send as a notice - e.g., "Please update your post or add a comment!". Certain AutoModerator placeholders are supported; use {{random}} to insert a random value from the ones given.).

reminder-random.label: Random Placeholder Values
reminder-random.helpText: Enter semi-colon separated values to be randomly selected for the {{random}} placeholder (e.g. "Value1; Value2; Value3").

reminder-options.label: Notice Options
reminder-options.helpText: Select moderator settings for the notice comment (comment is unlocked by default).

action-settings.label: Action Settings
action-settings.helpText: Settings for the action to take if the post is not updated or no comment is made.

missing-link-action.label: Action to Take
missing-link-action.helpText: What type of action to take.

missing-link-cross-action.label: Action to Take (crossposts)
missing-link-cross-action.helpText: What type of action to take for crossposts.

missing-link-delay.label: Action Delay (minutes)
missing-link-delay.helpText: Time (in minutes) to wait before taking the action.

report-reason.label: Custom Report Reason
report-reason.helpText: What report reason to use if the report action is selected?

change-flair-id.label: Flair Template ID
change-flair-id.helpText: If Change Post Flair is selected, what's the ID of the flair template that should be applied?

removal-reason.label: Removal Reason Name
removal-reason.helpText: If Remove Post is selected, what's the exact name of the removal reason template that should be used if any?

notify-user-via.label: Notify User via
notify-user-via.helpText: If a removal reason is given, how should the user be notified?

action-notify-options.label: Notify Comment Options
action-notify-options.helpText: If notify via comment is selected, what moderator settings should be used for the comment (comment is locked by default)?

modmail-archive.label: Archive ModMail?
modmail-archive.helpText: If notify via ModMail is selected, should the conversation be archived?
